title: Configure maubot
description: Configure the maubot Matrix bot system

host.description: Host name for the maubot management UI and plugin web endpoints, like 'maubot.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

admin_password.title: Admin password
admin_password.description: New password of the maubot user 'admin'; omitted or empty keeps the current one (generated on the first configuration)

homeservers.title: Homeservers
homeservers.description: Matrix homeservers the management UI can log bot accounts in to. Omitted keeps the current list.

name.description: Matrix server name, the part after ':' in user IDs

url.description: Client-server API URL of the homeserver

secret.description: Optional registration shared secret, to register new bot accounts from the UI
